feature-selector.title: Hey there 👋
feature-selector.description:
If you want to reduce the size of your images, transform them with stunning filters or protect them with distinctive watermarks, you've come to the right place.
Explore Pimp My Jpg's suite of tools to enhance and safeguard your images in an easy and privacy-friendly way.

image-compressor.title: Image Compressor
image-compressor.description: Reduce the size of your images and download them as JPGs to your device at maximum speed and without any limits on dimensions, format or number of files!

add-filter.title: Add Filter
add-filter.description: From vintage vibes to eccentric explosions of colour; turn your images into Renaissance masterpieces as you would with the best mobile phone apps!

add-watermark.title: Add Watermark
add-watermark.description: Apply a personal watermark to your precious images to prevent web crooks from misappropriating them!

image-compressor.title: Image compressor
image-compressor.description:
Reduce the size of your images in the blink of an eye by clicking in the box below or by dragging your files directly into it.
Use the options menu to set maximum width and height and quality limits.

Click or drop your file(s) here.
Any format is allowed!
